title: Formal Specifications with Data-Driven Signal Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.39007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developing analog and hybrid systems requires substantial domain knowledge that is hard to articulate in a formal specification; without additional effort, this domain knowledge is also inaccessible to machine learning methods. We propose a hybrid approach for analyzing and monitoring real-valued signals that integrates specification-based and data-driven techniques. We use regular expressions with interval operations to identify regions of interest in a signal, classical signal processing methods to extract semantically meaningful features, and semi-supervised machine learning to infer complex relationships that distinguish correct from faulty behaviors. The relationships learned from normal behavior data can automatically detect incorrect behavior in the same system or variants thereof. We evaluate the method on a voltage regulator, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting undesired system behaviors.

translated_title: 基于数据驱动信号分析的形式化规范
translated_abstract: 开发模拟和混合系统需要大量的领域知识，这些知识很难用形式化规范来表述；如果不付出额外努力，这些领域知识对机器学习方法而言也是不可获取的。我们提出了一种用于分析和监测实值信号的混合方法，该方法整合了基于规范的技术和数据驱动技术。我们使用带区间操作的正则表达式来识别信号中感兴趣的区域，使用经典信号处理方法提取具有语义意义的特征，并使用半监督机器学习来推断区分正确行为与错误行为的复杂关系。从正常行为数据中学习到的关系能够自动检测同一系统或其变体中的错误行为。我们在一个电压调节器上对该方法进行了评估，证明了其在检测不期望的系统行为方面的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种融合形式化规范与数据驱动技术的混合方法，通过带区间操作的正则表达式、经典信号处理和半监督机器学习来分析和监测实值信号，能够从正常行为数据中学习并自动检测模拟与混合系统中的异常行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid approach integrating specification-based and data-driven techniques—using regular expressions with interval operations, classical signal processing, and semi-supervised machine learning—to analyze and monitor real-valued signals, enabling automatic detection of faulty behaviors in analog and hybrid systems from normal behavior data.
